doc.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20

title: Butler: Louis Armstrong, Mexico band, Wellman Braud and a teacher
summary: Butler recalls Armstrong at the Suburban Gardens in 1931, taking over the Brown Buddies band in Mexico, favorite bassist Wellman Braud and his forgotten teacher.
